devanagari:
कराग्रे वसते लक्ष्मीः करमध्ये सरस्वती ।
करमूले तु गोविन्दः प्रभाते करदर्शनम् ॥
transliteration:
Karāgre vasate Lakṣmīḥ karamadhye Sarasvatī,
karamūle tu Govindaḥ prabhāte karadarśanam.
simple: Karagre vasate Lakshmih karamadhye Sarasvati, karamule tu Govindah prabhate karadarshanam

meaning.en: At the tips of my fingers lives Lakshmi, in the middle Saraswati, at the base Govinda. In the morning, I look at my hands with gratitude.
meaning.hinglish: Ungliyon ke sire par Lakshmi, beech mein Saraswati, aur jad mein Govind basate hain. Subah apne haathon ko shukriya ke saath dekhein.

devanagari:
ॐ सह नाववतु । सह नौ भुनक्तु ।
सह वीर्यं करवावहै । तेजस्वि नावधीतमस्तु ।
मा विद्विषावहै ॥ ॐ शान्तिः शान्तिः शान्तिः ॥
transliteration:
Om saha nāvavatu, saha nau bhunaktu,
saha vīryaṁ karavāvahai, tejasvi nāvadhītam astu,
mā vidviṣāvahai. Om śāntiḥ śāntiḥ śāntiḥ.
simple: Om saha navavatu saha nau bhunaktu saha viryam karavavahai tejasvi navadhitam astu ma vidvishavahai

meaning.en: May we be protected together, nourished together, and grow strong together. May our learning shine, and may there be only love between us. Peace, peace, peace.
meaning.hinglish: Hum saath mein surakshit rahein, saath mein poshit hon, saath mein shakti badhaayein. Hamara gyaan chamke, aur hamare beech sirf prem rahe. Shanti, shanti, shanti.

devanagari:
सर्वे भवन्तु सुखिनः । सर्वे सन्तु निरामयाः ।
सर्वे भद्राणि पश्यन्तु । मा कश्चिद्दुःखभाग्भवेत् ॥
transliteration:
Sarve bhavantu sukhinaḥ, sarve santu nirāmayāḥ,
sarve bhadrāṇi paśyantu, mā kaścid duḥkha-bhāg bhavet.
simple: Sarve bhavantu sukhinah sarve santu niramayah sarve bhadrani pashyantu ma kashchid duhkha bhag bhavet

meaning.en: May everyone be happy. May everyone be healthy. May everyone see goodness. May no one suffer.
meaning.hinglish: Sab sukhi rahein. Sab swasth rahein. Sab achha dekhein. Kisi ko dukh na ho.

title.hinglish: Mujhe roshni ki or le chalo

devanagari:
असतो मा सद्गमय । तमसो मा ज्योतिर्गमय ।
मृत्योर्मा अमृतं गमय ॥
transliteration:
Asato mā sad gamaya, tamaso mā jyotir gamaya,
mṛtyor mā amṛtaṁ gamaya.
simple: Asato ma sad gamaya tamaso ma jyotir gamaya mrityor ma amritam gamaya

meaning.en: Lead me from the untrue to the true, from darkness to light, from the passing to the everlasting.
meaning.hinglish: Mujhe asatya se satya ki or, andhere se roshni ki or, aur naashvaan se amar ki or le chalo.

devanagari:
वक्रतुण्ड महाकाय सूर्यकोटि समप्रभ ।
निर्विघ्नं कुरु मे देव सर्वकार्येषु सर्वदा ॥
transliteration:
Vakratuṇḍa mahākāya sūryakoṭi samaprabha,
nirvighnaṁ kuru me deva sarvakāryeṣu sarvadā.
simple: Vakratunda mahakaya suryakoti samaprabha nirvighnam kuru me deva sarvakaryeshu sarvada

meaning.en: O Ganesha, with the curved trunk and great form, bright as a million suns, please make all my work smooth, always.
meaning.hinglish: He Ganesh ji, mudi soond aur vishaal roop wale, karodon suraj jaise tejasvi, mere har kaam ko hamesha nirvighn banaiye.

devanagari:
सरस्वति नमस्तुभ्यं वरदे कामरूपिणि ।
विद्यारम्भं करिष्यामि सिद्धिर्भवतु मे सदा ॥
transliteration:
Sarasvati namastubhyaṁ varade kāmarūpiṇi,
vidyārambhaṁ kariṣyāmi siddhir bhavatu me sadā.
simple: Sarasvati namastubhyam varade kamarupini vidyarambham karishyami siddhir bhavatu me sada

meaning.en: Saraswati, giver of blessings, I bow to you. As I begin to learn, may I always find success.
meaning.hinglish: He vardaayini Saraswati, aapko pranaam. Main seekhna shuru karti hoon, mujhe hamesha safalta mile.

devanagari:
ॐ पूर्णमदः पूर्णमिदं पूर्णात्पूर्णमुदच्यते ।
पूर्णस्य पूर्णमादाय पूर्णमेवावशिष्यते ॥
transliteration:
Om pūrṇam adaḥ pūrṇam idaṁ pūrṇāt pūrṇam udacyate,
pūrṇasya pūrṇam ādāya pūrṇam evāvaśiṣyate.
simple: Om purnam adah purnam idam purnat purnam udachyate purnasya purnam adaya purnam evavashishyate

meaning.en: That is whole, this is whole. From the whole comes the whole. Take the whole from the whole, and the whole still remains. Like a mother's love: it never runs out.
meaning.hinglish: Woh poorn hai, yeh poorn hai. Poorn se poorn nikalta hai, phir bhi poorn hi bachta hai. Bilkul maa ke pyaar jaisa: kabhi kam nahi hota.

devanagari:
त्वमेव माता च पिता त्वमेव । त्वमेव बन्धुश्च सखा त्वमेव ।
त्वमेव विद्या द्रविणं त्वमेव । त्वमेव सर्वं मम देव देव ॥
transliteration:
Tvam eva mātā ca pitā tvam eva, tvam eva bandhuś ca sakhā tvam eva,
tvam eva vidyā draviṇaṁ tvam eva, tvam eva sarvaṁ mama deva deva.
simple: Tvam eva mata cha pita tvam eva tvam eva bandhush cha sakha tvam eva tvam eva vidya dravinam tvam eva tvam eva sarvam mama deva deva

meaning.en: You are my mother and my father, my family and my friend, my learning and my wealth. You are everything to me.
meaning.hinglish: Tum hi meri maa ho, tum hi pita, tum hi parivaar aur dost, tum hi vidya aur dhan. Tum hi mera sab kuch ho.

devanagari:
ॐ भूर्भुवः स्वः । तत्सवितुर्वरेण्यं ।
भर्गो देवस्य धीमहि । धियो यो नः प्रचोदयात् ॥
transliteration:
Om bhūr bhuvaḥ svaḥ, tat savitur vareṇyaṁ,
bhargo devasya dhīmahi, dhiyo yo naḥ pracodayāt.
simple: Om bhur bhuvah svah tat savitur varenyam bhargo devasya dhimahi dhiyo yo nah prachodayat

meaning.en: We meditate on the bright, loving light of the sun. May it awaken and guide our minds.
meaning.hinglish: Hum suraj ki pavitra, pyaari roshni ka dhyaan karte hain. Woh hamari buddhi ko jagaaye aur raah dikhaaye.

devanagari:
ॐ त्र्यम्बकं यजामहे सुगन्धिं पुष्टिवर्धनम् ।
उर्वारुकमिव बन्धनान्मृत्योर्मुक्षीय माऽमृतात् ॥
transliteration:
Om tryambakaṁ yajāmahe sugandhiṁ puṣṭi-vardhanam,
urvārukam iva bandhanān mṛtyor mukṣīya māmṛtāt.
simple: Om tryambakam yajamahe sugandhim pushtivardhanam urvarukam iva bandhanan mrityor mukshiya mamritat

meaning.en: We pray to Shiva, fragrant and nourishing. Like a ripe fruit gently leaving the vine, may we be free and full of life.
meaning.hinglish: Hum sugandhit aur poshan dene wale Shiv ki aaradhana karte hain. Jaise paka phal aaraam se bel se alag hota hai, waise hum mukt aur jeevan se bhare rahein.

transliteration:
Mātrā-sparśās tu kaunteya śītoṣṇa-sukha-duḥkha-dāḥ,
āgamāpāyino 'nityās tāṁs titikṣasva bhārata.
simple: Matra sparshas tu kaunteya shitoshna sukha duhkha dah agamapayino nityas tams titikshasva bharata

meaning.en: Cold and heat, joy and sorrow: they come and they go. They do not stay. Meet them with patience.
meaning.hinglish: Sardi-garmi, sukh-dukh aate hain aur chale jaate hain. Yeh tikte nahi. Inhe dheeraj se sahiye.

devanagari:
योगस्थः कुरु कर्माणि सङ्गं त्यक्त्वा धनञ्जय ।
सिद्ध्यसिद्ध्योः समो भूत्वा समत्वं योग उच्यते ॥
transliteration:
Yoga-sthaḥ kuru karmāṇi saṅgaṁ tyaktvā dhanañjaya,
siddhy-asiddhyoḥ samo bhūtvā samatvaṁ yoga ucyate.
simple: Yogasthah kuru karmani sangam tyaktva dhananjaya siddhy asiddhyoh samo bhutva samatvam yoga uchyate

meaning.en: Stay steady and do your work without clinging. Be calm in success and in failure. This calm balance is called yoga.
meaning.hinglish: Sthir rehkar, moh chhodkar apna kaam karo. Safalta aur asafalta mein ek samaan raho. Isi santulan ko yog kehte hain.

devanagari:
कर्मण्येवाधिकारस्ते मा फलेषु कदाचन ।
मा कर्मफलहेतुर्भूर्मा ते सङ्गोऽस्त्वकर्मणि ॥
transliteration:
Karmaṇy evādhikāras te mā phaleṣu kadācana,
mā karma-phala-hetur bhūr mā te saṅgo 'stv akarmaṇi.
simple: Karmany evadhikaras te ma phaleshu kadachana ma karma phala hetur bhur ma te sango stv akarmani

meaning.en: Your part is the doing, not the result. Don't work only for the reward, and don't give up working either.
meaning.hinglish: Tumhara haq sirf karm par hai, phal par nahi. Sirf inaam ke liye kaam mat karo, aur kaam chhodo bhi mat.
